the dialect also names such a callee with its type arguments (`FuncAsync<int>`, and the tail `InvalidOperationException>` of a two-argument list), a dialect fix that alone moves call_precision .7776 to .7853 (counterfactual run, not committed); (2) 368 are `nameof(x)`, which Roslyn and SCIP treat as an operator and the dialect lists as a call (a dialect fix); (3) 400 invoke a delegate-typed parameter, local or field (`callback(context, state)`, `predicate(item)`, `setter(p)`): SCIP records a reference to the local or parameter, not a callable, so the harness's truth has no pair, the same shape as Dart's (an oracle limitation, each sampled in the source); (4) 601 sit in a `#if` region the indexed target framework does not compile (`#if !HAVE_LINQ` in LinqBridge.cs, `#if !NETCOREAPP` in Polly's TimeoutRejectedException.cs and BrokenCircuitException.cs), which the dialect reads and scip-dotnet does not (the one-framework index of the Newtonsoft.Json run, LibraryFrameworks=net8.0); (5) 393 name a callee that has no reference anywhere in the oracle's document for the file although the source writes the call (mostly generated designer files, SqlTypesDataSet.Designer.cs and LinqToSqlClasses.designer.cs, 76 pairs, and the test helpers TraceableAction.cs, ChaosOutcomeStrategyTests.cs: `this.Reset()`, `instance.GetType()`, `Assert.IsNotNull(o)`): an omitted occurrence; the cause was not isolated; (6) 879 name a callee the document references elsewhere: a call written in a chain after a generic call whose own occurrence is missing (`Policy.Handle<DivideByZeroException>().WaitAndRetryAsync(...)`: no occurrence for either, WaitAndRetryAsyncSpecs.cs:503-505) or attributed to another enclosing definition under the D5 span fallback (1,190 Polly and 2,334 Newtonsoft.Json SCIP definitions are unmapped); sampled, not resolved per pair. Leaving out the oracle-side categories (1), (3) and (4), which are verified in the source, the dialect's precision would read .9463 (28,902 of 30,542); that is disclosed, not scored, and no pattern or threshold moved
